spline.s_rule: N * budget_m**2 separately for observation-local forward and left coordinates

boundary_anchor_policy: Fit only native tau=0.1..3.0. For boundary query in [0,0.1), a separate linear observation-origin to fitted-first-point bridge is permitted; not a spline extrapolation or fitting datum. Native support endpoints use one-sided derivatives.
revision_basis: Fixed RAW FRESH +/-0.2s chord T and left normal, using existing graph chord validity rules on full native support; same basis for RAW and every fit. Also retain FRESH observation-body forward/left components for prior-audit comparability.
editable_policy: Reuse existing full/clip time construction, then retain queries strictly after switch+1e-8; report previous boundary-inclusive editable metrics separately.
phase_policy: Reuse original audit phase_at at each observation for chunk residuals and actual FRESH application for pairs. Straight=initial_travel or hallway_straight; left_turn separate; retain approach/near_goal/each phase and bootstrap separately.
execution_direction_policy: Reuse preceding saved execution direction and quality checks from existing graph configuration, plus original audit numerically-valid direction as separately labeled context.
supplemental_example_rule: Do not replace four prescribed pairs. Among nonbootstrap pairs valid across three splines, additionally show largest decrease/increase in robot-heading seam for spline03; persistence example is closest smoothed/raw full-RMSE ratio to 1 among upper-half RAW full-RMSE cases. These are descriptive selections, not categorical thresholds.
policy_note: No per-chunk budget search, no joint OLD/FRESH fit, no observation-frame change, no graph rerun/tuning, no future measured target. Fitting residual is a variation/model-mismatch proxy, not independent ground-truth noise. Coordinatewise adaptive-knot spline fits are not invariant to changing local fitting axes; global world transforms keep original local axes fixed.
